initial_plan.can_answer: yes, for the average number of police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday in records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; not crash risk per trip or traffic exposure
initial_plan.metric: average number of crashes per covered calendar occurrence of each weekday
initial_plan.denominator: number of dates of that weekday in 2013-2025
initial_plan.population: one police-reported motor vehicle crash per row, with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
filters: crash_date in 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; missing crash_date excluded because it has no weekday
initial_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check_findings.rows: 2,132,218 rows in the planned population; per-year row counts are in check_2.csv
data_check_findings.crash_date_quality: 0 missing crash_date rows in the file and 0 rows at the checked sentinel dates 0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, and 9999-12-31
data_check_findings.year_coverage: Each year 2013-2025 has rows on both January 1 and December 31; endpoint presence does not establish that every intervening date is represented.
data_check_findings.effect_and_decision: No rows are excluded for a missing or sentinel date; all dated rows in the selected years receive a weekday and count once. Use the actual number of calendar dates for each weekday in the full calendar-year span as the denominator; no partial endpoint year requires adjustment.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for the average number of police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday in the available records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; the data do not measure traffic exposure or crashes per trip
final_plan.metric: average crashes per occurrence of weekday = crashes dated on that weekday divided by the number of calendar dates of that weekday in 2013-2025
final_plan.denominator: the actual count of Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday dates in the complete calendar-year span 2013-2025, respectively
final_plan.population: one police-reported motor vehicle crash per row with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive; no other filters
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; all have observed records at both calendar-year endpoints, though internal date coverage is not verified
final_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, ordered Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Police-reported crash records are counts, not exposure-adjusted risk. There are no missing dates or checked sentinel dates; all selected years span their first and last calendar days, but the check does not prove complete reporting on every intervening date. The denominator is calendar weekday occurrences, not verified days of complete crash reporting.
